title: Simple Network Time Protocol (SNTP) Version 4 for IPv4, IPv6 and OSI
summary: SNTPv4 is a simplified subset of the Network Time Protocol for devices that need to set their clocks over the network but do not need the full precision of NTP. It clarifies header formats and a simple, stateless request-and-response mode for IPv4, IPv6, and OSI. It also gives guidance to makers of home and business devices on avoiding abuse of time servers. It obsoleted RFC 1769 and RFC 2030, and was itself replaced by RFC 5905.

eli5.summary: Instead of wearing a perfect watch that you keep adjusting, you just ask a friend what time it is and set your watch from the answer. Simple gadgets do that with a time server.

questions: how do simple devices sync their clocks
